events.title: 🎉Happy anniversary! 1,000 wishlists here!🎉
events.summary: Hey everyone!A few days ago our game hit 1,000 wishlists, and it keeps growing. We're so happy that "Chief? About That File..." is finding players who like it. On behalf of our small but driven team - thank you, every single one of YOU!Right now we're working hard on the Investigation Board mechanic, to make the gameplay of tracking down crime gang leaders as fun as possible. We hope you'll enjoy it!With gratitude and best wishes, Desk Lamp

events.title: Thank you for 500 wishlists! ❤️
events.summary: 🎉Over 500 people have wishlisted our game!🎉For us, this isn’t just a number — it’s a sign that we’re moving in the right direction. We’re continuing to actively work on the game’s demo, which you’ll be able to play during the upcoming Steam festival! We’re really looking forward to hearing your feedback =)A huge thank you to everyone who has added Chief? About That File... to their wishlist.
